summary: Iteration 46 — SM order filter (admin+IM) + NEW /api/sm/telecaller-performance + TC Performance tabs on Admin/SM/IM dashboards. Backend: 15/15 pytest tests passing. v2/orders honours sales_manager_id only for admin+inventory_manager (no leakage to other roles), inventory/orders honours sales_manager_id and 403s for non-admin/IM, sm/telecaller-performance returns full {range,from,to,sm_id,team,telecallers[],totals{}} shape with correct default 'today/7d/30d' handling, 400 on bad custom dates, 400 when admin omits sm_id, 403 for telecaller, and per-TC aggregation verified (created TEST_TCPerf_* order via telecaller1 — orders/qty/revenue increment correctly in the SM-scoped 'today' view). Frontend (Playwright): EVERY spec'd data-testid is present and renders correctly — Admin (admin-tab-tcperf, admin-tcperf-sm-select, tc-performance-cards with range chips today/7d/30d/custom + totals strip orders/qty/revenue/in_transit/delivered/returned + per-TC cards w/ Call+WhatsApp buttons + delivery_pct/rto_pct bars; orders-sm-filter dropdown in Orders panel filter row). Sales Manager (tab-tcperf with NO picker — auto-scoped to self; Hubby Brahman's team shows Ravi Kumar Asst SM card). Inventory Manager (inv-sm-filter in filter bar, inv-tab-tcperf, inv-tcperf-sm-select picker with TelecallerPerformanceCards below). Default range is 7d when no param passed. WhatsApp wa.me/91XXXXXXXXXX format confirmed in code review of _wa() / TelecallerPerformanceCards.jsx. No business-logic or UI defects detected.
critical_code_review_comments: sm_performance.py is a clean, self-contained module — team is correctly resolved as (telecallers managed_by sm_id) ∪ (assistant_sales_managers managed_by sm_id); SM scoping is enforced server-side regardless of any client-supplied sm_id (line 44-47), preventing cross-team leakage from a malicious SM client.
delivery_pct / rto_pct are computed against (delivered+returned) — the 'final-state' denominator — which correctly avoids penalising TCs for in-transit orders. Spec'd correctly.
v2/orders sales_manager_id branch only runs when role∈{admin,inventory_manager} (line 161 upgrades.py). Other roles' team-scope cannot be overridden — secure.
inventory/orders SM team resolution duplicates _sm_team_ids logic (server.py 6391-6396) — minor DRY violation; could call the shared helper but functionally identical.
TelecallerPerformanceCards.jsx renders WhatsApp links via wa.me/91XXXXXXXXXX (non-digits stripped, leading 91 normalised) — matches the global telephony convention used elsewhere (post_office._wa).

success_rate.frontend: 100% — every data-testid in the spec verified across Admin/SM/IM dashboards
